topicName: How do you create and use procedures in PL/SQL?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"How do you create and use procedures in PL/SQL?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"PL/SQL procedures are named blocks of code that perform specific tasks.
